evidence: Registered QA Tester with qatest.tim2026@example.com, password Passw0rd!, location Seattle WA. Toast "Account created successfully!" shown, header switched to show user's name "QA Tester" and Sell button, confirming signed-in session.

Login attempt with nonexistent-user-xyz@example.com showed toast "Invalid credentials. Try: emma@example.com", remained on /login unauthenticated (header still showed Log in/Sign up prior to this later test).

issue: Duplicate email not rejected on registration
actual: Registering with "QATest.Tim2026@Example.com" (case-only variant of existing qatest.tim2026@example.com) succeeded, creating a new account "Duplicate Tester" with toast "Account created successfully!". Registering again with the exact same email "qatest.tim2026@example.com" also succeeded, creating yet another account "Exact Dup Tester". No duplicate-account error was shown and the original account was not preserved as the sole owner of that email.

Attempting to register with an already-used email (exact and case-variant) did not produce any duplicate-account error; instead the app silently created a new account and navigated away from the registration form to the home page with a success toast.

Logging in as emma@example.com with an arbitrary incorrect password "randompass" succeeded and created a signed-in session (header showed "Emma Green" as logged-in user). The app itself documents this on the login page: "Demo accounts: emma@example.com, marcus@example.com, sofia@example.com (any password works)". Additionally, for a self-registered account (qatest.tim2026@example.com), even the correct password "Passw0rd!" was rejected with "Invalid credentials" after duplicate accounts were created for that email, so password-based authentication is broken in both directions.

evidence: Submitting the create-listing form fully empty kept native browser required-field validation blocking submission (title/description/price marked required). Submitting with title, description, price filled but no category/condition selected showed toast "Please fill in all required fields" and did not create a listing. Submitting with title, description, price, category, condition, location filled but no photo attached showed toast "Please add at least one image" and did not create a listing (still on /create-listing).

Price field is a native number input with min="0"; entering -5 and submitting triggered native validation "Value must be greater than or equal to 0." and blocked submission (no listing created, stayed on /create-listing). Entering non-numeric text "abc" was rejected by the number input itself (value reverts to empty), which combined with the required attribute blocks submission via "Please fill out this field."

Created listing "QA Vintage Leather Jacket" with photo, description, price $88, category Clothing, condition Good, location Brooklyn NY, and upcycled toggle on. Toast "Listing created successfully!" shown, appeared in My Listings as Active, and detail page at /product/prod-1787575028213 correctly displays photo, title, $88 price, Clothing category, Good condition, Brooklyn NY location, Upcycled badge, description text, seller Emma Green, and listed date 2026-08-24.

issue: No edit functionality for existing listings
actual: The My Listings page only exposes "View", "Mark Sold", and "Delete" actions for each owned listing — there is no "Edit" button or any UI path to modify a listing's title, description, photos, price, category, condition, location, or upcycled status. The listing detail page (viewed as owner) only shows a "Manage Your Listings" link, which returns to the My Listings list; no edit form or field is reachable from anywhere in the app.

evidence: Clicking "Mark Sold" on owned listing "QA Ceramic Vase Set" showed toast "Item marked as sold", changed status badge to "Sold" and button to "Mark Available"; clicking that restored status to "Active" with toast "Item marked as available". Clicking "Delete" opened a confirmation dialog "Delete listing? This action cannot be undone."; confirming showed toast "Listing deleted" and the listing was immediately removed from My Listings.

After marking Emma's "Mid-Century Modern Armchair" (prod-1) as Sold, Browse grid dropped from 10 to 9 items and no longer listed it. Searching "Armchair" (as a logged-out/buyer-context user) returned "No items found" - the sold listing is fully excluded from search results too, so it's unreachable via any normal browse/search path. Viewing the item's own product page (as owner) showed "This item is no longer available" with no purchase actions, only a "Manage Your Listings" link. Since no link anywhere in the buyer-facing UI points to the sold listing, it cannot be added to cart or used to start a purchase request through normal navigation.

Applying category filter "Furniture" alone returned 2 items (Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf $320, Upcycled Pallet Coffee Table $175, both New condition). Adding condition filter "Like New" on top (Furniture + Like New combined) correctly returned "0 items available"/"No items found", proving filters combine with AND logic rather than being ignored or OR'd. "Clear all filters" reset the state back to 9 items."

Selecting "Price: Low to High" from the sort combobox correctly reordered the 9 browse items to ascending price: $35, $45, $55, $65, $95, $125, $175, $180, $320. Sort options also included "Newest First" (default), "Price: High to Low", and "Distance".

Typing "Armchair" into the search box (no Enter/submit pressed) immediately updated results to "0 items available"/"No items found". Clicking category/condition filter checkboxes immediately updated the item count and grid (e.g. Furniture checkbox alone → instantly showed 2 items, no submit button used). Changing the sort combobox to "Price: Low to High" immediately reordered the grid with no page reload or explicit submit action.

Listing detail page for "Handmade Macrame Wall Hanging" (/product/prod-5) displayed all expected content consistently: photo image, breadcrumb (Home / Home Decor / title), category "Home Decor", condition "New", title, price "$45", location "Brooklyn, NY (3 mi)", listed date "Listed 2024-11-21", full description text, Upcycled badge, and Seller section with seller photo, name "Emma Green" and location "Brooklyn, NY". Availability is represented by presence of active "Add to Cart"/"Message Seller" buttons (vs. "This item is no longer available" text with no purchase buttons for sold items, confirmed earlier on prod-1). All fields matched the data entered/expected for the item with no missing or mismatched values.

Added "Kids Wooden Train Set" ($35, seller Sofia) and "Vintage Denim Jacket - Size M" ($65, seller Marcus) to cart as Emma. Cart page (/cart) correctly listed both items with photo, title, location, and individual price, showed "2 items" count, and computed Total as $100.00 (35+65), matching sum of item prices exactly.

Clicking "Add to Cart" on a product page immediately (no reload) showed a toast "Added to cart!" and updated the header cart icon badge count from empty to "1" then to "2" in real time as each item was added, without navigating away or requiring a page refresh.

Clicking "Send Purchase Request" on the 2-item cart ($100 total) showed toast confirmation "Purchase requests sent to sellers!", cart immediately emptied to "0 items" / "Your cart is empty" state, and header cart badge count reset - confirming the request submission succeeded with clear confirmation feedback.

Clicking the "Furniture" category quick-select button on the home page correctly filtered the Browse grid to show "2 items available" (Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf $320, Upcycled Pallet Coffee Table $175 - both Furniture category), matching the count seen earlier when manually checking the Furniture filter checkbox. The Filters sidebar's Furniture checkbox was also automatically checked, confirming state consistency between the category shortcut and filter panel.

While logged in as Emma Green, viewing listings owned by other sellers (Sofia Martinez's "Kids Wooden Train Set" prod-9, Marcus Chen's "Vintage Denim Jacket" prod-2) only exposed buyer actions "Add to Cart" and "Message Seller" - no "Mark Sold", "Delete", or "Manage Your Listings" seller-management controls were present, confirming those actions are correctly restricted to the listing's owner.

issue: No seller-facing UI to view or manage received purchase requests
actual: As Emma, added Marcus Chen's "Vintage Denim Jacket - Size M" to cart and successfully sent a purchase request (toast "Purchase requests sent to sellers!", cart cleared). Logged in as Marcus Chen (the seller) afterward and checked both the account dropdown menu (only "My Profile", "My Listings", "Log out" - no "Purchase Requests"/"Orders"/"Offers" option) and the My Listings page, where the "Vintage Denim Jacket - Size M" listing still shows status "Active" with only View/Mark Sold/Delete actions and no badge, count, or any indication that a purchase request was received. There is no discoverable UI anywhere in the app for a seller to view, accept, or decline purchase requests sent by buyers.

evidence: Confirmed unauthenticated users are blocked from multiple buyer/seller actions: (1) Clicking "Add to Cart" while logged out redirected to /login with toast "Please log in to add items to your cart". (2) Clicking "Message Seller" while logged out opened a dialog "Send a message to James Wilson" with a textbox but the submit button was disabled and labeled "Log in to message", preventing message submission. (3) The header only exposes "Log in"/"Sign up" buttons when logged out - no "Sell" button or account menu (which houses "My Listings"/create-listing access) is rendered at all, so listing creation/management and cart/purchase-request flows are not reachable without authentication.

Clicking "Message Seller" opened a modal dialog with a "Send Message" button that stayed disabled until text was entered. Typing a message enabled the button; clicking it immediately showed a toast "Message sent to seller!" and auto-closed the dialog, all without a page reload or navigation change (URL remained /product/prod-10 throughout).
